<summary>
Task: Build a D3.js v6 single-page web app at /root/output/index.html with a bubble chart (clustered by sector, sized by market cap, ETFs uniform, tooltip on hover except ETFs, ticker labels, legend) side-by-side with a linked data table, plus supporting files under /root/output/{js,css,data}.

Turns 1–4 (data exploration): Agent inspected /root/data. Found stock-descriptions.csv with 60 lines total (header + 50 stocks + some multi-line rows from embedded newlines in longBusinessSummary), and 50 CSVs in indiv-stock/. Parsed with Python csv.DictReader and confirmed exactly 5 sectors × 10 tickers: Information Technology (AMZN, MSFT, AAPL, INTC, NFLX, CSCO, AMD, FB, NVDA, TSM), Industry (BA, TSLA, CSL, FDX, GE, HON, MMM, NLSN, RHI, UPS), Energy (MPC, CLR, HFC, MRO, PXD, TRGP, DVN, NEE, EOG, XOM), Financial (JPM, V, MA, C, BAC, WFC, SCHW, MET, BLK, RY), and ETF (SPY, VOO, QQQ, GLD, XLF, VWO, XLU, XLV, VEA, VTV) with empty marketCap. Non-ETF stocks all have numeric marketCap.

Turn 5: Created output directory tree, copied stock-descriptions.csv and all indiv-stock CSVs to /root/output/data/, and downloaded d3.v6.min.js (270687 bytes) into /root/output/js/.

Turn 6: Wrote /root/output/index.html — links css/style.css, loads js/d3.v6.min.js in <head>, has #bubble-chart, #legend, #stock-table (with columns "Ticker symbol", "Full company name", "Sector", "Market cap"), #tooltip div, and js/visualization.js loaded at end of body inside a .dashboard flex container.

Turn 7: Wrote /root/output/css/style.css with a horizontal flex .dashboard layout, chart panel fixed-width 780px, scrollable table panel, bubble styles (selected class = darker/thicker stroke), .bubble-label styling, sticky table header, tbody tr.selected highlight, sector-tag pill, and absolute-positioned tooltip.

Turn 8: Wrote /root/output/js/visualization.js implementing: sector palette for 5 sectors, cluster centers arranged on a circle around chart center (radius = 0.24 × min dim), formatMarketCap producing T/B/M suffixes with 2 decimals, d3.csv load, scaleSqrt radius scale (14–52) for non-ETFs, uniform ETF radius 20, legend items, SVG with viewBox 740×640, force simulation using forceX/forceY per sector center (strength 0.18), forceManyBody strength 3, forceCollide(r+2) iterations 3, tick clamping to viewport, tooltip on hover suppressed for ETFs, click toggles selection, bidirectional highlight between bubbles and table rows (table sorted with named sectors alphabetically then ETFs last, market cap desc within sector, includes scrollIntoView on selection).

Turn 9: Verified file structure — index.html, css/style.css, js/d3.v6.min.js, js/visualization.js, data/stock-descriptions.csv, and 50 CSVs in data/indiv-stock/ all present.

Turns 10–11: Started local python http.server on :8765 (had to inline commands with &&); all six endpoints (index.html, both js files, css, and both CSV paths) returned HTTP 200.

Turns 12–14: Found node available (no chrome/playwright); installed jsdom in /tmp for headless verification.

Turn 15: Wrote /tmp/check.js — a jsdom script that loads http://localhost:8765/index.html with runScripts and resources enabled, waits 2500 ms, then reports counts of bubbles, labels, table rows, legend items, sample row text, first bubble transform/r/fill, unique bubble colors, and any errors. Script created but not yet executed in this window.
</summary>
